content.text: The verifier's substantive checks all confirm the compliant conclusion; the two "failed" deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artefacts of there being no covenant to measure. I'll re-submit with that expressly addressed, and no redline (correct output for a compliant finding).

input.quote: Each General Manager shall have the authority to make and convey decisions on behalf of each Party and to be the liaison with the other Party for all production and Content matters.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding the Company. I read the full operative text (sec-p0001, sec-1.4, sec-5.4 including the General Manager/liaison appointment, Exclusivity §6, Confidentiality §8, Warranties §9 and General Provisions §10) and ran targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "employ or engage", "induce", "personnel" and "directly or indirectly"; the only hits are incidental (the confidentiality carve-out reference to HDI's employees and the no-joint-venture wording in §10.2), neither of which restricts either Party from soliciting or hiring the other's people. Because the rule's preferred position is "No non-solicit on Customer", the absence of any such covenant satisfies the preferred position outright — this is not a "missing" clause, since the rule does not expect a restriction to exist. The deterministic sub-checks for a 12-month duration limit and a general-solicitation carve-out register as failed only because there is no restriction to measure them against; with no covenant, there is nothing to narrow and no carve-out is needed. The Section 6 exclusivity covenants (including §6.1 binding the Company as to competing Deerskin-branded web projects) concern competing projects rather than personnel and are addressed under the separate exclusivity rule, so they are not double-flagged here. No redline and no counterparty comment are warranted.
